scientific_question: Is there sufficient source bird-day support within the same French wild Gyps fulvus 5km space and calendar month for a bird-specific regional wind response to improve on the independently estimated population-shared wind reaction?
earlier_CERRA_missing: All Jul-Dec 2021 CERRA 100m wind hourly values null; original 1050 calendar day floor fails. This result remains separate and will not be revised.

new_independent_weather.source_colony_location: Published Grands Causses Cassagne colony/feeding-station 44d12N 3d15E independent of tracked bird GPS
new_independent_weather.wind_regimes: Each YYYY-MM among all calendar days, classify full 24-hour daily mean of site-wide ERA5 100m wind <= monthly Q25 as low and >= monthly Q75 as high; no biological outcomes used.
new_independent_weather.spatial_caveat: At ~25km the climate variable is a regional site-level weather indicator, not flight-experienced airflow, actual thermals, wind shear or local orographic uplift. Do not call this a 5km meteorology exposure simply because movement 5km cells are compared.

source_and_sample.native_event_proxy: GPS speed 5-55m/s, valid time, XY and native source visible/outlier flags; first valid source GPS per biological bird-day UTC 5min bin before altitude
source_and_sample.original_tag_alias_182208: Two native bird IDs share a tag; BOTH excluded before new wind response source selection.
source_and_sample.shared_population_same_cell_month: At least two OTHER biological birds each with >=10 same-5km-cell first-5min GPS events in BOTH low and high site-wide wind states, excluding target day, within YYYY-MM

original_biological_evidence_boundary.eligible_new_source_birds_are_only_poten: No new response calculated until ERA5 and exact same-cell month source donor support passes.
original_biological_evidence_boundary.result_status: PROSPECTIVE_WEATHER_SUPPORT_ONLY, biologically exploratory extension of height dataset already seen.

future_model_if_source_passes.H0: Species-population-shared wind reaction applied to each bird's wind-pooled daily-centered vertical shape accounts for regional wind-related changes.
future_model_if_source_passes.H1: The individual's same-cell wind-conditioned daily-centered vertical distribution predicts separate-date GPS altitude events better than shared species wind response, beyond environmental regional wind as a common effect.
future_model_if_source_passes.heldout: one entire UTC bird-day per target; exclude target bird and target date when estimating species shared response, target other-dates only for own bird.
future_model_if_source_passes.comparison: Matched exact selected GPS events in each model; 10 native altitude bins, each day centered to native height day-median; measure average log P_bird_wind / P_species_wind and equal bird-day, state, biological bird weighting.
future_model_if_source_passes.calibration: 999 swaps of WHOLE calendar-day low/middle/high ERA5 regional wind labels within same YYYY-MM, synchronously across all birds to respect common weather, source eligibility recalculated per null, min 950 valid nulls, conservative p upper.
future_model_if_source_passes.native_height: Paired GPS+barometric height from original source available only once source is admitted; source native tag alias excluded before target endpoints.
future_model_if_source_passes.cannot_claim: Only association of shared regional wind with individual vertical shape, not causal uplift or evolutionary adaptation; animal-specific reaction inference is exploratory in reused French source.

no_rescue: Do not silently modify CERRA 912-day gate or report ERA5 as 5km CERRA. If ERA5 strict 5km SAME-MONTH other-bird winds fail, keep unavailable, do not broaden to 50km or relax donor days after outcome.
